how: The index fell 33.9% in the next 23 sessions.
The VIX closed above its three-month measure for the first time in the decline.

t: −4.4%: 10% below the record in six sessions
how: Close 2978.76. The index fell another 24.9% to the low.
The cut did not hold the market for a day.

t: Oil price war: −7.6% and the first trading halt
how: A market-wide circuit breaker halted trading. Close 2746.56.
SPY traded 2.6 times its 50-day average. The index rose 9.3% the next session and lost it all on the following one.

t: Rates cut to zero on Sunday: −12.0%; VIX 82.7
how: The cut and $700bn of bond purchases were announced on 15 March. The record VIX close came five sessions before the price low.
S&P 500 −5.2% to 2398.10. Third lending programme in two days.

t: Fed: unlimited purchases and a corporate-bond backstop
how: Announced at 8am. S&P 500 −2.9% to the closing low, 2237.40. The high-yield spread peaked at 1,087 basis points; VIX 61.6.
Each of the three days had over 80% of issues and volume rising.
Close 2541.47. The only pullback of the turn bottomed three sessions later, 10.4% above the low.
Eighth session after the low. Close 2526.90.
S&P 500 +1.5% to 2789.82, already 24.7% above the low.
Session 45, 35.7% above the low. Lost again on 11 June.

t: NYSE breadth thrust, 50 sessions after the low
how: Advances 2.07 times declines over ten days by Deemer’s rule. Close 3122.87.
